layouts.title: MUSICAL KEYS
layouts.body: The buttons on the left of the keyboard change the instrument and the way the song is played.To change songs, choose a tab on the songbook or the page corner.  The buttons below the printer button choose short or long songs.Choose the songbook with the pencil to make your own songs, or copy this song to your songbook with the button next to the printer.Follow Look-A-Lot down the ladder to a game!

layouts.title: ANIMAL ALBUM
layouts.body: Click on one of the small trait buttons at the top of the machine to set a trait.  Then choose one of the animal group buttons below to select an animal group that has the trait you picked.Click on an animal and drag it into the scene.  Drag an animal out of the scene to send it home.  Choose the dog button below to remove all the animals.To see a whole new set of animals, click on the sun or moon.Click the bush button to play Guess My Animal.

layouts.title: ROAD RALLY
layouts.body: Be the first to reach your goal!  Click the die to see how many blocks you can drive.  Then choose an intersection to drive to.Try to finish in an intersection with a clover or a happy face.Click the button next to the tiny treehouse to change the game.  (This ends your game.)

layouts.title: MUSICAL MAZE
layouts.body: Try to guess the mystery song!  You earn a note of the song when you match the sound clue you hear with the correct sign.  To hear the clue again, click the 'possum.After you have earned some notes, click the ? to guess the song.  Click the small notes below the ? to hear the notes you've earned so far.Click the tiny keyboard to return to Musical Keys.

layouts.title: GUESS MY ANIMAL
layouts.body: Pick one of the clues in the scene.  Or choose ? to guess your animal; then click on the animal you think is behind your bush.Click on an animal to see its traits.After you pick a clue, click the small hands to turn thumbs down to the animals that don't match the trait.  Click on the hand again to turn thumbs back up.Click the second button left of the tiny treehouse to change the game (this ends your game).  The first button returns you to the Animal Album.

layouts.title: ROAD RALLY
layouts.body: Choose the chip game or money game.  (The money game is easiest.)Choose to play with a friend or Bonga Bot.Choose your game goal.  If you're playing with a friend (Look-A-Lot), choose Look-A-Lot's goal too.  The two goals can be different.  If you're playing with Bonga Bot, it will use the same goal as you.Click on PLAY to begin.

layouts.title: ROAD RALLY
layouts.body: Click on the tray that will give you the most chips.  If you're playing with Bonga Bot, you get to choose its tray.In the left tray, add the chips you already have (the number in the top machine) to the chips in the tray.  In the right tray, subtract the number of chips you already have from the total chips (the number at the bottom of the tray) to figure out how many chips are in the bag.

layouts.title: DEDICATED TO JANESE SWANSON
layouts.body: This product was the culmination of the undying efforts of many individuals.  I would like to dedicate my contribution to the one who shined above all the rest for me.  To the lady who inspired me to undertake the project, drove me crazy throughout, and has made it so much more than worthwhile in the end.  Life will never be fair Janese.  Remember that the truly good people will come out ahead in the end.  I love you.                                           Lance
